title: Retry with fallback in Effect 4
notes: Effect 4.0.0 shipped as stable on 2026-10-01, but v4 betas were public from early 2026 (before the model's June 2026 cutoff), so the model may have seen some v4 material; this case is weaker evidence than the others. In v4 the Either module became Result (Success/Failure with .success/.failure), Effect.either became Effect.result, and Effect.catchAll became Effect.catch. The v3 idiom from memory (Either, Effect.either, Effect.catchAll) fails the type check against 4.1.2.
